title: TCP
description: An external system sends data over TCP: either it connects to Sentinel on a port you choose (listen), or Sentinel connects to it (connect). Default format: sentinel.v1.Observation, binary protobuf length-delimited, or JSON one per line.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: listen: senders connect to Sentinel. connect: Sentinel connects to the sender.

port.title: Port
port.description: listen: the port Sentinel opens (1024-65535). connect: the remote port.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: For the sentinel format: binary protobuf (length-delimited) or JSON, where each line is one observation or an array of up to 100

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: Override the framing the format implies

decoderOptions.title: Decoder options
decoderOptions.description: The decoder's options. json: a field map, with at least fields.latitude and fields.longitude; empty uses the default map (see docs/feeds.md). nmea-gps: sourceEntityId, the platform the receiver reports (required), and optionally name and entityType. cot: skipSite, a site id whose own events are dropped.

defaultSource.title: Default source
defaultSource.description: Source for sentinel messages that leave it unset

allow.title: Allowed senders
allow.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to connect; empty allows anyone who can reach the port

maxMessagesPerSecPerSender.title: Max messages per second per sender
maxMessagesPerSecPerSender.description: How many messages a second one sender (one IP address, however many connections it opens) may send, within the limit above that all senders share. 0 = no per-sender limit. Senders behind one NAT share a limit.

readTimeoutSec.title: Idle timeout (seconds)
readTimeoutSec.description: close a connection that sends nothing for this long; 0 = never

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Certificates and keys come from the tlsCert, tlsKey, clientCa and serverCa secrets, never from file paths.

requireClientCert.title: Require client certificates
requireClientCert.description: Mutual TLS, verified against the clientCa secret. It applies in listen mode only; connect mode ignores it.

serverName.title: Server name
serverName.description: connect: name to verify on the remote certificate

tlsCert.title: TLS certificate (PEM)
tlsCert.description: listen: the certificate Sentinel presents. connect: an optional client certificate.

serverCa.title: Server CA (PEM)
serverCa.description: Signs the remote's certificate; empty trusts the system roots.
